We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 38653) to the molecule given. The molecule is from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 answer: a list of three SMILES (each a single product? Actually those are possible product forms? The answer shows list of lists each containing one SMILES string. Those are likely the target molecule (maybe with protecting groups). So we need to apply the template to each of those molecules and get precursors.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id. We need to apply to each SMILES.

Let's extract the three SMILES:

1. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"
2. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"
3. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"

We need to apply template 38653 to each. Use apply_template tool.
